company.name: Etleap
company.shortDescription: Etleap is an ETL solution for creating perfect data pipelines from day one.
company.description: Etleap is an ETL solution for creating perfect data pipelines from day one. Unlike other enterprise solutions, Etleap doesn’t require extensive engineering work to set up, maintain, and scale. Etleap builds tools to make data analytics teams more productive. It automates most ETL setup and maintenance work and simplifies the rest into 10-minute tasks that analysts can own.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-native, managed ETL/ELT platform for building, operating, and maintaining data pipelines from diverse sources to warehouses and data lakes.
productsAndServices.name: Etleap Data Pipeline Platform

productsAndServices.description: A managed data ingestion service that continuously transfers data from databases, applications, files, APIs, and event streams into cloud warehouses and data lakes.
productsAndServices.name: Etleap Ingestion

productsAndServices.description: A managed pipeline solution for ingesting, transforming, and operating Apache Iceberg tables, including automated maintenance and schema evolution.
productsAndServices.name: Fully-Managed Iceberg Pipelines

productsAndServices.description: A data transformation and modeling capability that shapes data in flight through wrangling or builds SQL-based models with dbt Core.
productsAndServices.name: Transform and Model

productsAndServices.description: An integration service for connecting Etleap to source systems that are not covered by standard connectors or user-defined API connections.
productsAndServices.name: Custom Data Integrations

productsAndServices.description: Technical support for operating Etleap pipelines, including direct access to ETL-capable engineers through private Slack and Microsoft Teams channels.
productsAndServices.name: Etleap Customer Support
